prompt:
Hive and Spark's FROM-first multi-table INSERT (FROM x INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE a SELECT ... [INSERT ... SELECT ...]) fails to parse. It should parse into exp.MultitableInserts with no kind, including when it starts with a CTE, and be generated back in the same FROM-first form for Hive and Spark; other dialects should get an unsupported warning. LATERAL VIEWs after a leading FROM (FROM x LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(y) t AS a SELECT a) must keep working.

For example:

```python
from sqlglot import parse_one, transpile, exp

parse_one("FROM x INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE a SELECT k, v", read="hive").sql("hive")
# currently: ParseError: Invalid expression / Unexpected token. Line 1, Col: 13.
# expected:  FROM x INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE a SELECT k, v

parse_one("FROM x AS v INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE a PARTITION(ds = '1') SELECT v.k WHERE v.os = 'ios' INSERT INTO c SELECT v.os", read="hive").sql("hive")
# currently: ParseError: Invalid expression / Unexpected token. Line 1, Col: 18.
# expected:  FROM x AS v INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE a PARTITION(ds = '1') SELECT v.k WHERE v.os = 'ios' INSERT INTO c SELECT v.os

transpile("FROM x LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(y) t AS a SELECT a", read="hive", write="presto")[0]
# currently: ParseError: Invalid expression / Unexpected token. Line 1, Col: 44.
# expected:  SELECT a FROM x CROSS JOIN UNNEST(y) AS t(a)
```

Other forms of the same constructs described above should work as well.

prompt_original:
feat(hive)!: support FROM-first multi-table INSERT [CLAUDE] (#8527)

Parse Hive/Spark `FROM x INSERT ... SELECT ... [INSERT ... SELECT ...]`
into exp.MultitableInserts with no kind, including a leading CTE, and
generate it back in that form; other dialects get an unsupported warning.
LATERAL VIEWs after a leading FROM are now parsed once for every
FROM-first statement, so `FROM x LATERAL VIEW ... SELECT ...` parses too.
